title: All Decked Out | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Fully Renovated Home Overlooking Seacrest Beach Community Lagoon Pool- All Decked Out by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: All Decked Out by Royal Destinations Location: Seacrest Beach Address: 47 Cobia Run W Details: Searching for the perfect Florida escape? Look no further than All Decked Out! Aptly named, this home has been ‘All Decked Out’ to ensure an inviting ambiance for you and your guests to relax and enjoy your stay. This 30A vacation rental has undergone a full renovation and boasts fresh coastal calm décor, designer furnishings, and tasteful artwork. Wooden floors, paneled ceilings, and a harmony of muted colors reflect the sand and driftwood just a short stroll away. This 30A vacation rental features an incredible third floor deck area overlooking the resort-style community pool and is complete with multiple seating areas and a ping-pong table. After enjoying a quintessential Florida day at the nearby beach access and spacious community pool, this is sure to be your favorite spot to end the perfect day. Although the beach is only a short walk away, Seacrest Beach provides a convenient tram service during peak seasons, bringing you even closer to the shore. Nestled between the charming towns of Rosemary and Alys Beach, this Seacrest beach rental is just a short stroll or bike ride away from world-class dining, boutique shopping, and delightful late-night treats. Those searching for Seacrest Beach vacation rentals are sure to fall in love with this home, making it their new favorite getaway on 30A! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 350 Yards (5 Minute Walk or Short Ride On The Seasonal Seacrest Beach Tram) -Third Floor Balcony Overlooking Seacrest Community Pool With Ping-Pong Table And Multiple Seating Areas -4 Adult Bikes -Parking Spaces: 2 Spaces in Driveway -Dining Accommodations: Table Seating for 6, Bar Seating for 3 -Coffee Maker Available -Gas Grill (Propane Provided) -Access to Community Pool -Available For Winter Monthly Rentals In November and February- Contact Reservations for winter monthly rental rates. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 12 4 Bedrooms / 4 Bathrooms First Floor: -Bedroom 1: King Bed with Shared Bath (Shower) -Kitchen / Living Area / Dining Area -Laundry room Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) Third Floor: -Loft: 2 Twin over Twin bunks with Shared Bath (Shower) -Queen sleeper sofa -Kitchenette -Great Balcony Please Note: *Construction is currently taking place directly behind the house as exciting improvements are underway in the amphitheater area. As a result, the back gate leading to the pool and bar area is temporarily closed. To reach the pool, simply step outside and head just two houses south, where you'll find the main entrance conveniently located. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Home Sweet Home: A Note From The Homeowner- This home is perfectly located for families—backing directly onto Seacrest’s large community pool with easy access from the back porch, and just a short walk to the beach. Though tram service is nearby, it's rarely needed. Enjoy decks on all three levels, including a third-floor deck with stunning sunset views and peaceful mornings with coffee. The bunk room is great for kids, and the ping pong table is a hit with all ages. Nestled between Rosemary and Alys Beach, you’re just steps from shops, dining, and all the fun of 30A.
